summary.name: Capacity TTS (CereProc)
summary.one_liner: A neural text-to-speech engine from Capacity (listed as CereProc) that turns written text into natural-sounding speech for contact centers, IVR systems and brand voices.
use_cases: Automated outbound customer calls and reminders
Creating a custom brand voice for customers
Replacing legacy TTS engines in contact centers
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Capacity TTS, a neural text-to-speech engine that generates natural, human-like speech with control over tone and clarity. It supports multiple languages and dialects (stated as over twenty four) with male and female voices, and custom voices can be developed for a brand. It integrates with contact center platforms via MRCP (versions 1 and 2) or gRPC APIs and is designed to work with Capacity's ASR for two-way conversations. It can be deployed on-premise, in private or public cloud, hybrid, or as Capacity-hosted SaaS, using containerized microservices.
notable: Neural TTS with human-like tone and intonation
MRCP and gRPC API integration as a drop-in replacement for other TTS engines
Over 24 languages and dialects with custom brand voice option
caveats: Pricing is not stated; sales contact is required to get started
Newer 'Ion' voices are described as a preview coming soon
Designed mainly for enterprise contact centers rather than individual users
